name: kit_roundtrip
title: A module made from words becomes a kit, and the kit installs back as the same module, empty

steps.say: watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles
steps.reply:
I'm now watching We Work Remotely's Back-End Programming category. I read it once, and it has 3 roles listed right now:

- **Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems**, Squarespace. Full-time, new today.
- **Senior Java Developer**, Twikey. Full-time, new today, open to a set of European countries.
- **AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)**, Upgrade. Full-time, posted 3 days ago.

I ignored the "Remote Customer Support" ad on that page, since it's a promoted listing and not a back-end role.

I set it to check every day at 09:00, or when your Mac next wakes, and tell you what's new or gon
steps.routed_by: judge: Watching We Work Remotely for back-end roles is a standing watch that will keep running over time, and no open item covers it.

steps.detail: Installed the kit Job watch (v1): 1 table, 1 skill, 1 agent. Its agents are paused until you turn them on; a reader of a site needs your sign-in there first.
